$comment: EFB-87 fixture. The same entry as allowlist-stale-renamed.json, plus a written reason why detection cannot see the read. The escape hatch has to be proven to WORK, not just to exist: a hatch nobody can demonstrate opening is one the next person routes around by deleting the check. Declared debt still carries a sunset and is still reported — it is acknowledged, not exempt.

unmigrated.scanner_blind_reason: Reads its body through readRequestBody, a cross-file helper the one-level-deep resolver cannot follow. Verified by inspection.
